messages:
elaine: quick heads-up — config gate kicked for new llamaX onboarding. validator says missing "serve_constraints" and tokenizer.variant mismatch with weights URI. here's minimal failing snippet:
```json
{"model_name":"llamaX-13B","weights_uri":"gs://redwood-models/llamax/13b/v1/","tokenizer":{"type":"sentencepiece","variant":"spm-small"}}
```
Anyone seen this? we used to assume defaults but lint now enforces explicit serve_constraints.

marco: saw that. config-lint-bot wants explicit `serve_constraints.cpu` and `serve_constraints.gpu_type`. we should either add defaults in schema or fix onboarding script to inject them.

config-lint-bot: ERROR: missing required property "serve_constraints" at / (schema v2.1). consider adding `{ "serve_constraints": {"gpu_type":"a10","min_replicas":1}}`.

ash: i'd prefer schema default for min_replicas=1 but not for gpu_type — that's infra-specific. propose schema allows `gpu_type: null` and runtime maps null->customer-default. less surprising.

rachel: runtime fallback sounds good but needs an audit trail in logs and an opt-out flag. otherwise customers won't know what we picked.

marco: ok — short plan: (1) ash opens schema PR to accept null for gpu_type + default min_replicas. (2) i update onboarding script to inject defaults when missing for hosted onboarding only. (3) runtime team adds log line `serve_constraint_source` to inference logs. PRs by EOD?

elaine: cool. i'll patch the model config in the repo for llamaX and add test case that simulates validator.

ash: assigning to @ash and @marco. i'll add a quick unit test for validator that asserts `gpu_type` nullable handled.

rachel: ping me for the runtime logging change review.

elaine: thanks — will follow up with PR links. :thumbsup:
